name: C-Walk AI Dance
blurb: One photo in: the person in it does the C-Walk, heel-toe shuffles, V-steps and a spin, in a 12-second vertical clip.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo: keep every person in it exactly as photographed, same faces, hair, skin tones, builds and outfits, in the same place the photo was taken; if the setting is unclear, a sunny backyard lawn with tall hedges behind. Camera fixed at waist height, vertical 9:16, one continuous shot. (1) They nod to the beat, hands loose at the waist. (2) They break into the C-Walk: fast heel-toe shuffles, feet twisting in and out, quick V-steps forward and back, heel taps and a toe spin, knees loose and bouncing, upper body cool and upright, hands near the hips. (3) A last quick shuffle, a spin on one heel, and they stop square to the camera with a small nod. Smooth realistic motion, full bodies always in frame, feet always visible. Audio: an original laid-back West Coast G-funk beat with a deep bassline and synth whistle, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
